notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Gameplay Fixes
notes.content:
This update is aimed at players who had trouble understanding how to progress through the game by making certain mechanics clearer.

⚡ The power lever is now more clearly explained and easier to understand.

💻 The security booth computer now requires you to run the .exe file in order to gain access to the facility.

🔑 Two keys inside the facility have been removed. (Note: This does not affect gameplay.)

🟩 Side note: The green keycard is still hidden in one of the rooms. Don’t forget to search carefully!

🎮 If you couldn’t finish the game due to the first two issues, you should now be able to complete it without trouble.
